sources.title: Xum src/node/services/agentSession.ts
sources.locator: AgentSession imports and turn execution; AIService; docs/config/providers.mdx
sources.finding: The integrated agent session uses Xum own AIService/model-provider loop and Xum workspace tools. Configurable providers and imported agent definitions do not launch Claude Code, Codex or another external coding harness as the workspace agent.

sources.title: Xum src/node/runtime/runtimeFactory.ts
sources.locator: createRuntime switch and RuntimeConfigSchema in src/common/orpc/schemas/runtime.ts
sources.finding: The complete product runtime factory implements local, worktree, SSH including user Coder workspaces, Docker and devcontainer. It has no VM-isolation backend; using an SSH machine that happens to be a VM is separate.

sources.title: Xum src/node/services/serverAuthService.ts
sources.locator: Device-flow owner matching and persisted server sessions; docs/config/server-access.mdx authentication modes
sources.finding: Server authentication uses a bearer token or exactly one allowed GitHub username. The owner check rejects other logins. No role, organization-membership, SAML or enterprise SSO flow exists in this authentication model.

sources.title: Xum src/node/orpc/router.ts
sources.locator: workspace.sendMessage lines 2210-2213 and onChat lines 2411-2416; workspaceService.ts shared sessions map and attachSessionSubscriptions; server-access token mode
sources.finding: Authenticated browser clients call the same workspace sendMessage endpoint and subscribe to its chat events. WorkspaceService reuses one AgentSession per workspace and broadcasts its chat events; input is not tied to the client connection. Trusted people sharing the server bearer credential can therefore prompt the same work. Separate GitHub human identities remain restricted to one owner.

sources.title: Xum src/common/orpc/schemas/workspace.ts
sources.locator: Workspace metadata, child-task metadata and schemas; src/node/services/taskService.ts; bounded issue/backlog/ticket searches across schemas and workspace service
sources.finding: The pinned task model stores agent workspaces, child task/workspace execution, session goals and in-session todos. Source inspection found no separate product issue/backlog schema or human issue-state workflow distinct from agent workspaces.

sources.title: Xum pinned provider configuration
sources.locator: Quick Setup and complete provider/key configuration
sources.finding: Users enter their own provider API keys or configure local model endpoints. Model calls are charged by the selected provider rather than bundled as an Xum inference allowance.

sources.title: Xum src/cli/server.ts
sources.locator: Server bootstrap and service lifetime, independent of browser connections
sources.finding: The standalone Xum server initializes the application backend and provider sessions before serving browser clients. Browser transport connections do not own the backend process. On a separate user server, the backend can continue while the controlling laptop is offline; local-desktop and local-backend SSH modes are different.

sources.title: Xum src/node/orpc/router.ts
sources.locator: Complete backend API and bounded src search for payment, billing services, paid-plan gates and license keys; docs/install.mdx and public release inventory
sources.finding: The pinned AGPL desktop/server distribution exposes its application operations without a paid-account or paid-feature gate. The complete local backend API has no ADE billing/payment service or tier selection. Published installers can run with user provider credentials; provider costs and user compute are separate. This finding is scoped to the public open-source distribution.
